name: Eni S.p.A. (Eni Award)
program: Eni Award 2027 (Advanced Environmental Solutions, Energy Transition, Energy Frontiers main prizes)
collect_note: Eni's own Eni Award page (server-rendered HTML, no JavaScript) carries the 2027 round block with the application deadline (November 20th, 2026; Eni for Innovation Recognitions January 31st, 2027) and its Apply link to the official candidate portal eniaward2027.net. Each prize's Official Announcement PDF and regulations sit on eni.com (AEM DAM), but the PDFs carry no machine-readable deadline line, so the monitored item is the round itself; a new round (new year) changes its text and deadline.
